name: cloud-logging-configuration-basics
description: >- Configure single-project Cloud Logging on Google Cloud: regional log buckets, log sinks, log views, restricting or hiding sensitive logs in the default view (_Default) filter, IAM permissions for views (Logs View Accessor, IAM conditions), logs-based metrics, log exclusions, and sampling. Don't use for cross-project logging or multi-project setups.
author: google
